current.text: He re-signed with Atlanta on a 1-year, 14 million USD deal.
He is the backup center behind Onyeka Okongwu and part of a projected 10-man rotation off the bench.
Atlanta's center depth is thin. Veesaar is out for the season and Gueye is injured.
If Okongwu got hurt, Landale would start and play 30-plus minutes. That makes him the best stash on the team, but only in deep stash formats.

durable.text: He is a center who can shoot from outside, which fits Quin Snyder's five-out offense.
He gets very few steals, well below the top 250 pool.

note: Yahoo ranks him 282nd with a 0 USD value, and he was not drafted in our league last season. He is far outside our 144-player auction, so do not draft him. His projection is thin: 0.3 steals, 0.2 blocks and 8.5 points. The 81.6% FT projection also looks generous after he shot 63.5% last season. Treat him as an Okongwu handcuff on waivers. If Okongwu misses time, use FAB on Landale, since thin center depth would give him 30-plus minutes.
